column1: # R12 AVA re-layout zone W3 (U1 escape and MCU core), D-R12-96; generated, see escape_W3.tsv.
# frozen R12 copper reused verbatim (r12_routes_f1.tsv): PYRO1_GATE_N, ACT_EN_MCU, PYRO1_CONT (W3 part), HSE_IN / HSE_OUT
# aft face: sensor bus to W4
# aft-east: CA lanes, SWD, camera UART, USB
# east: AUX lane CX, QSPI (tight quadrant fallback b, CLK F only)
# VCAP1 / VCAP2 to C19 / C20 on B
# forward: CF port-UART bus on B under J430
# microSD: SD_CS / SD_MOSI hop on B under the pocket, SD_SCK / SD_MISO on F
# west face: power dog-bones, LEDs, ARM1, VLOGIC / CAM / NRST sense, 3V3A, decouplers
# D-R12-99 (90 mm outline): QSPI_NCS passes aft of the moved pull-up row (y 60.9), forward between C20 and J430
# (x 26.6), aft of J430 (y 63.0) and up x 29.4 west of the QSPI_IO3 / 3V3 copper to its old y 65.9 run.
# D-R12-99 (90 mm outline): CX turns west at y 66.4 / 66.8 (forward of U3, aft of the port buck) and runs north at
# the series-resistor x (35 / 36) to vias at y 80.0; F tails to R471 / R470.
# D-R12-98 integration: ACT_EN_MCU B outside the NRST In2 lane (no B over NRST)
# D-R12-98 integration: BAT_FAULT_N on F over the In2 lanes
# D-R12-98 integration: NRST pocket via inside ACT_EN_MCU, In2 lane under B pour only; C24 beside J2 run
# D-R12-98 integration: HSE_OUT 0.08 mm aft so the NRST / CAM pocket vias (y 52.9) clear it by 0.48 mm (K-reference)
# D-R12-98 integration: E4-E6 GND tie to (22.2, 50.8); IO2 lane clear of non-3V3 vias
# D-R12-98 integration: port UART dives at the J8 / J9 dog-bones and two K-row vias, 0.5 mm B pitch (every lane >= 0.5 mm from a foreign via); one GND via (25.225, 58.1) partners all four
# AVA pass: AUX pair dives beside U3 (x 37.9 / 38.9), one GND partner (37.9, 52.95); B lanes 1.0 mm pitch turn together at y 65.4 / 66.4
# R12F5-TRI-01 (S-10, lane P): C13 turned to 0 degrees at (17.4, 50.0), GND pad toward PE4's lane, its 3V3 via west of
# the VLOGIC_SENSE In2 lane at (15.05, 50.45), where In2's 3V3 joins the main sheet (the strip between the VLOGIC_SENSE
# and NRST lanes is closed): C13.1 and the via keep >= 1.06 mm from PYRO1_GATE_N (0.48 / 0.53 mm).
# R12F5-TRI-21: GPS_TX_MCU leaves K9 straight aft, then one 45-degree step to its via (the 0.15 mm jog had no purpose
# QSPI to U3 (38.5, 54.45) rot 90: west pins IO0 52.545 / CLK 53.815 / IO3 55.085 / VCC 56.355 at x 34.97, east GND / IO2 / IO1 / NCS at x 42.03
# port UART dog-bones J8 / J9 moved to the H/J sites so QSPI_NCS takes the J/K channel east
# AUX: F east, B under U3, south along x 43.1 / 43.6 under the card overhang, west to the J440 hand-off vias
# BUZZ_DRV: B from (22.2, 60.9) west under C22 / C14 to the W5 hand-off (SD_CS crosses on F)
# AUX diagonals south-west under J430 to the J440 hand-off vias (85 mm board)
# RADIO_TX hand-off via 0.4 mm west, clear of C406.1 (PORT_4V8, I-5 port class)
